INFO:ckks_fed.log_utils:  ├─ plaintext_size  = Σ(v.numel() × 4)
INFO:ckks_fed.log_utils:  ├─ ciphertext_size = Σ(len(ct.serialize()))
INFO:ckks_fed.log_utils:  ├─ num_ciphertexts = Σ(len(v) for v in encrypted_update.values())

INFO:ckks_fed.log_utils:  ├─ total_comm      = upload_cost + download_cost
INFO:ckks_fed.log_utils:  └─ expansion_ratio = total_ciphertext_size / total_plaintext_size
